segments.text:
V. 26.
At that day ye ſhall aſk—For true Knowledge begets Prayer. And I ſay not, that I will pray—This in no wife implies, that He will not: It means only, The Father Himſelf now loves you, not only becauſe of my Interceſſion, but alſo becauſe of the Faith and Love which He hath wrought in you.
